title: CMB low-ℓ map product row
description: One canonical Planck 2018 PR3 component-separated CMB sky-map product. Single row_type catalogue ('map_product'); each row records the pipeline (Commander/NILC/SEVEM/SMICA), product kind (cmb_iqu / common_mask), HEALPix Nside, FITS filename, PLA + IRSA download URLs, expected file SHA-256, FITS data shape (I,Q,U Stokes; nested ordering; Galactic coordinates), beam FWHM, and per-row Planck-paper provenance. Phase 2 uses these descriptors to fetch + verify the actual FITS bytes at runtime.

map_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier (e.g., 'smica-iqu-r300-full'). Used in cite_as / purpose templates.

pipeline.description: Component-separation pipeline. Commander = parametric Bayesian sampling; NILC = Needlet Internal Linear Combination; SEVEM = Spectral Estimation via Expectation Maximisation; SMICA = Spectral Matching Independent Component Analysis. 'mask' rows describe the canonical Planck common-mask products applied at low-ℓ analysis.

product_kind.description: Product type. 'cmb_iqu' = full Stokes I,Q,U temperature + polarisation map. 'common_mask_int' = sky-area mask for intensity analyses. 'common_mask_pol' = sky-area mask for polarisation analyses. 'inpainting_mask_int' = mask defining regions filled by inpainting in low-ℓ products.

healpix_nside.description: HEALPix Nside resolution. Planck PR3 distributes T at Nside=2048 (5 arcmin FWHM), Q+U at Nside=1024 (10 arcmin FWHM) for component-separated maps; masks at Nside=2048.

healpix_ordering.description: HEALPix pixel ordering. Planck distributes nested ordering by convention.

coordinate_frame.description: Sky coordinate frame. Planck distributes galactic coordinates by convention. For AoE analysis, galactic-coordinate axes are typically converted to ecliptic for comparison with the ecliptic-plane alignment reading.

fits_filename.description: Canonical FITS filename as distributed by PLA/IRSA, e.g., 'COM_CMB_IQU-smica_2048_R3.00_full.fits'.

download_url_pla.description: Direct download URL from the Planck Legacy Archive (PLA) `aio/product-action` endpoint. Pattern: http://pla.esac.esa.int/pla/aio/product-action?MAP.MAP_ID=<filename> for maps, ?SOFTWARE.FILE_ID=<filename> for software. Served without authentication.

download_url_irsa.description: Alternate mirror URL from NASA/IPAC/IRSA at Caltech. Pattern: https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/data/Planck/release_3/all-sky-maps/maps/component-maps/cmb/<filename>. Equivalent bytes to PLA URL.

file_size_bytes.description: Expected file size in bytes. Approximate (varies slightly across mirrors due to FITS comment-block differences). Used as a sanity gate before computing response_sha256.

expected_response_sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the FITS bytes (lowercase hex, 64 chars). 'pending' for rows where the hash has not yet been computed from a live PLA download (Phase 2 first-fetch will populate). Distinct from the row-level response_sha256 in the MPR attestation block — this is the EXPECTED FILE-content hash, used to verify Phase 2 downloads against catalog-time canonical bytes.

beam_fwhm_arcmin.description: Approximate beam FWHM in arcmin. PR3 component-separated maps are typically delivered at 5 arcmin (T) / 10 arcmin (Q,U); the exact effective beam is delivered as a separate transfer function in the FITS headers per Planck 2018 IV.

stokes_components_available.description: Stokes components present in the FITS HDU(s). 'I' = temperature; 'Q','U' = linear polarisation; 'TMASK','PMASK' = mask layers. For cmb_iqu products this is typically ['I','Q','U']; for masks, ['TMASK'] or ['PMASK'].

ell_max_recommended.description: Recommended maximum multipole for AoE / low-ℓ analyses using this product. PR3 component-separated maps support ℓ up to ~Nside×2 in principle; for low-ℓ multipole-vector work ℓ ≤ 8 is safe margin.

principal_reference_doi.description: DOI of the canonical Planck paper describing this product's construction. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201833881 (Planck 2018 IV — diffuse component separation).

principal_reference_label.description: Human-readable label of the principal reference, e.g., 'Planck Collaboration 2018 IV: Akrami et al. 2020 A&A 641:A4'.

confirmation_reference_dois.description: DOIs of key companion / re-validation references. Typically Planck 2018 VII (isotropy, 10.1051/0004-6361/201935201) for AoE-analysis context.

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. Map products from PR3 are 'high' precision (published gold-standard sky maps).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — typical use cases, AoE-analysis suitability, known systematics, or links to companion files.

source_doi.description: DOI of the primary citation for this row's facts. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201833881 (Planck 2018 IV).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the source paper.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Planck release version, e.g., 'PR3/R3.00' or 'PR3/R3.01' (SEVEM was re-released at R3.01).
